title: JANUS: Evaluating Goal-Conditioned Distortion in Factually Grounded LLM Communication
abstract: arXiv:2606.10852v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM deception is often evaluated through fabricated claims, explicit lies, or strategic concealment. Yet misleading communication can also arise from selectively presenting true facts, for example, by omitting adverse evidence, softening unfavorable details, emphasizing favorable information, or replacing precise qualifications with vague language. Existing benchmarks largely overlook this subtler failure mode. We introduce JANUS, a benchmark for measuring goal-conditioned pragmatic distortion in fact-grounded LLM outputs. Each of its 160 scenarios, spanning 8 domains, provides a fixed pool of favorable and adverse facts and contrasts a neutral decision support with institutional conditioning, such as increasing adoption, or support despite potential harm to affected individuals or groups. By constraining outputs to the same fact pool, JANUS isolates misleading net impressions from hallucination and fabrication. Experiments acr

translated_title: JANUS：评估基于事实的LLM沟通中的目标条件性失真
translated_abstract: LLM欺骗行为通常通过捏造的声明、直接的谎言或策略性隐瞒来评估。然而，误导性沟通也可能源于对真实事实的选择性呈现，例如省略不利证据、淡化不利细节、强调有利信息，或用模糊语言取代精确的限定表述。现有基准大多忽视了这种更为微妙的失败模式。我们提出了JANUS，一个用于衡量基于事实的LLM输出中目标条件性语用失真的基准。其160个场景涵盖8个领域，每个场景提供固定的有利事实与不利事实池，并将中立的决策支持与机构性条件设置（例如提高产品采用率，或在可能对受影响个人或群体造成伤害的情况下仍给予支持）进行对比。通过将输出限制在同一事实池内，JANUS能够将误导性的整体印象与幻觉及捏造行为区分开来。实验……
tldr: 本文提出JANUS基准，通过在固定事实池约束下对比中立与机构性条件设置下的LLM输出，专门评估LLM在基于事实沟通中通过选择性呈现真实信息所产生的目标导向性误导失真。
